_meta.scenario: Action authorization — agent requests data:read on patient records, covenant permits with scope constraint

prior_signal_digest.comment: Digest of the trust_verification signal from step 1 (onboarding). Any verifier can confirm this agent was identity-verified before requesting action authorization.

covenant.source:
permit data:read where resource.type == "patient_record" and requester.clearance >= "hipaa_certified"
forbid data:write where resource.classification == "phi"
require audit_log for all actions

enforcement.matched_rule: permit data:read where resource.type == "patient_record" and requester.clearance >= "hipaa_certified"

crosswalk.note: Maps Nobulex-native fields to the canonical governance_attestation schema per crosswalk/nobulex.yaml

verification.instructions: To verify this fixture independently: (1) SHA-256 the covenant.source field and confirm it matches covenant.hash. (2) Verify authorizationSignature over authorizationHash using signerPublicKey (Ed25519). (3) Verify resultSignature over resultHash using the same key. (4) Confirm prior_signal_digest.digest matches the trust_verification artifact from step 1. (5) Confirm action_log_entry.hash chains to the next signal via prior_signal_digest in step 3.
